summary: Executed backend API pytest suite and frontend end-to-end flow for upload -> processing -> results -> analytics including CSV export and link activity fields.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error for malformed ZIP content with .zip filename instead of returning a 4xx validation error.

action_items: Handle zipfile.BadZipFile in /api/screener/analyze and return HTTP 400 with user-friendly detail.
Add regression test for malformed ZIP to backend test suite once API behavior is fixed.
Refactor /app/backend/server.py (>700 lines) into modules (parsing/scoring/link-validation/routes) to improve maintainability and lower defect risk.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 700+ lines and mixes routing, parsing, scoring, external HTTP checks, and persistence in one file; high maintenance and regression risk.
Input validation gap: analyze endpoint validates extension only, not ZIP integrity; uncaught BadZipFile triggers 500.
seed_data_creation: Created local test artifacts in /app/test_reports/fixtures (jd.txt, alice.txt, bob.txt, resumes_test.zip) for automated test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Happy path is stable for analyze/results/analytics/export and UI flow. Reproduce open defect by posting non-zip bytes as resumes_zip with filename fake.zip to /api/screener/analyze; currently returns 500 due to uncaught zipfile.BadZipFile.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/screener/analyze with jd_text plus a non-zip file but forced filename extension .zip. Result: HTTP 500. Backend log shows traceback from extract_resumes_from_zip -> zipfile.ZipFile -> zipfile.BadZipFile at server.py line 406/492. Mitigation: wrap ZIP extraction in try/except BadZipFile and raise HTTPException(400, detail='Invalid ZIP file').
